scope: Publicly documented Gotaleden Stafett & Ultra editions through the audit date
import_eligibility: An edition requires an attributable event source and real result records. Announcements and future registrations are not result data.
conclusion: No additional historical edition exists for import beyond the already canonical 2026 premiere edition.

future_announcements.reason: The official site announces the future event, but no race has taken place and no results source exists at the audit date.

source_material.data_limitations: Finish-list files contain one row per participant/team at Mål. Official intermediate observations come only from the preserved public contestant snapshot; zero-valued placeholders are excluded and no split is synthesized.

comparison_and_identity_boundary.course_versions: Only the verified 2026 course-v1 is assigned. No cross-year course equivalence is asserted.
comparison_and_identity_boundary.person_identity: No cross-year identity links can be established from a single edition. Existing source-event-scoped identities remain unchanged.
comparison_and_identity_boundary.history_activation: The generic history engine remains ready for additional real editions, but production history UI correctly stays inactive with one available edition per family.

sources.evidence: The event describes 9 May 2026 as the first edition and announces 8 May 2027 as the next event.
The official results archive exposes only 2026 and links its four formats to EQ Timing event 77906.
EQ Timing event 77906 is the attributable result source for the four 2026 race editions.
The project record describes a new event with the first event scheduled for 9 May 2026.
Contemporary reporting states that no race had previously existed on Gotaleden and announces the 2026 premiere.
Post-event reporting identifies 9 May 2026 as the premiere and 8 May 2027 as the planned next edition.

non_import_decisions.reason: Multiple independent records identify 2026 as the event premiere; no earlier RaceEdition exists.
Future announcement only; importing it as available data would fabricate results, provenance and history.
